definitions.explanation: A person who has committed a crime; the perpetrator of a crime.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{捕|つか}まっていない→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal hasn't been caught yet.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We were able to identify the culprit.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{逃走|とうそう}→逃走：14403_tousou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {犯人|はんにん} refers specifically to someone who has committed a crime. It's commonly used in news reports and crime stories.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {犯人|はんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧ (to catch the criminal)
- {犯人|はんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to arrest the criminal)
- {犯人|はんにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ (the criminal escapes)
- ⟦{真|しん}{犯人|はんにん}→真犯人：28193_shinhannin⟧ (the real culprit)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {犯人|はんにん}⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧ (criminal's arrest)
- {犯人|はんにん}⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧ (search for criminal)
- {犯人|はんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目星|めぼし}→目星：15941_meboshi⟧ (suspect/lead on the criminal)
- {犯人|はんにん}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (profile of the criminal)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧ - suspect (formal, legal)
- ⟦{被疑者|ひぎしゃ}→被疑者：22237_higisha⟧ - suspect (legal term)
- ⟦{犯罪者|はんざいしゃ}→犯罪者：19219_hanzaisha⟧ - criminal (general term)
